name: Charly
beschreibung:
Conveniently and peacefully situated, Pension Charly welcomes visitors to the famous alpine hub of Soelden. The pleasantly furnished rooms provide every comfort needed for an invigorating summer or winter getaway in Tyrol.

Gondola stations, local dining, and shops are within easy walking distance. It serves as an excellent starting point for glacier skiing and alpine summit hikes.
kurzbeschreibung: Pension Charly in Soelden offers cosy rooms and friendly family hospitality in the heart of the Oetztal valley.
